card.title: Health Check for a Model Dependency

a1.cap: Kubernetes should stop routing traffic to an instance whose model server is unreachable. Add a custom Actuator health indicator that reports DOWN (with details) when the model server's ping fails.

lines: Kubernetes should stop routing traffic to an instance whose model server is unreachable. Add a custom Actuator health indicator that reports DOWN (with details) when the model server's ping fails.

a1.cap: Any bean implementing HealthIndicator joins the aggregate /actuator/health result under a name derived from its class. If any component is DOWN, the endpoint answers 503, which load balancers and Kubernetes probes understand.
a1.say: Any bean implementing Health Indicator joins the aggregate /actuator/health result under a name derived from its class. If any component is DOWN, the endpoint answers 503, which load balancers and Kubernetes probes understand.

a1.cap: The bean name model becomes the component name in the health JSON.
Implementing HealthIndicator plugs into Actuator automatically.
a1.say: Implementing Health Indicator plugs into Actuator automatically.

a1.cap: Ping the dependency, ideally with a short timeout.
Healthy: report UP, plus the latency as a useful detail.
Unhealthy: DOWN makes /actuator/health return 503, so traffic shifts away.
